extraction.Name: Earl Sickler
extraction.Refused/Protested: never applied for a patent in fee and did not know a patent had been issued to him when he signed the deed and did not know what he was signing when he signed the deed
extraction.Recorded patent: never received a receipt for a patent in fee and did not know that a patent was issued for him
extraction.Buyer: James Garner; $500.00 down, remainder paid in 30 days, $1300.00 at signing of deed; $1600.00 in all
extraction.Occupation/Income: worked at odd jobs and has tried to make a living by his labor
extraction.NOTES: Sale occurred spring of 1920, Feb. or March 1920; deponent went with Garner to Kadoka, S.D. to complete sale; deponent states land should be worth more than he received; never had much schooling, fourth grade is as high as he ever went; did not know what he was doing but was told everything would be all right; has a wife but no children; has a hard time making a living owing to lack of proper schooling and was not able to judge for himself; sworn before notary public April 20, 1929 in Washabaugh County, South Dakota
